timeline.summary: While walking through the forest, the Tin Woodman tells his story. He recounts his family, his love for a Munchkin girl, and the old woman and Wicked Witch of the East opposing their marriage. Repeated axe injuries led to tin replacements that left him without a heart or love. He describes becoming immobilized by rust until help came. He now intends to ask Oz for a heart and, if granted one, return to marry the girl. Dorothy and the Scarecrow understand why he wants a heart.
